experiment_title: Step 3: Controlled Transfer Study — FP16 vs Always-On FP8 vs Adaptive Policy
core_research_question: Does GPU compression reduce complete handoff latency for any tested configuration, and does the policy choose appropriately?

empirical_answer.summary_verdict: Uncompressed FP16 outperformed FP8 across all tested configurations on this interconnect; FP8 wire savings did not overcome codec and formatting overhead.

hardware_telemetry.transport_architecture: Localhost TCP Socket with CPU Staging
hardware_telemetry.transport_notes: Independent OS processes communicate over 127.0.0.1 TCP socket with host-memory staging. Measures network stack serialization, framing, and socket buffer handoff; does not utilize direct CUDA IPC or NVLink P2P access.
